items.title: Avramov-type regularity: a perfect map into a target over a local complete intersection base forces both maps to be complete intersections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Given a commutative diagram of schemes over a locally Noetherian base S, with Y -> S locally of finite type, f : X -> Y perfect, and X -> S a local complete intersection morphism, the lemma concludes X -> Y is a local complete intersection morphism and Y -> S is Koszul at every image point of X. The retained proof works entirely in the Noetherian world where regular and Koszul-regular sequences agree; after affine localization it chooses nested closed immersions into affine spaces over S, reads off the kernels J of O_{A^{n+m}_S, x} -> O_{X,x} and I of O_{A^n_S, f(x)} -> O_{Y,f(x)}, notes J is generated by a regular sequence (X -> S is lci) and O_{X,x} has finite tor dimension over O_{Y,f(x)} (f perfect), and applies the divided powers algebra lemma that a perfect map whose ambient ideal is generated by a regular sequence forces both I and J/I to be generated by regular sequences (Divided Power Algebra, lemma-perfect-map-ci). Retained author proof at lines 18376-18418.
